## Concept

**The assumption that breaks first.** That cell density is constant across the section, so one radius means one thing everywhere.

## Failure mode

**What it produces.** Enrichment reported without stating the graph, so a result that exists only at one radius is read as biology.

**The diagnostic that catches it.** Sweep the radius and plot the statistic against it; a real signal is a plateau, an artefact is a spike.
